verdict.rationale: Sill's Mac host has Settings › Devices, which lists paired devices and lets you remove (revoke) one, and only paired devices can connect. Nothing shows the host displaying who is connected right now or ending a live session. This covers the revoke half of the story, not the live-presence and disconnect half. Missing for 10: a host-side view of currently active connections, the ability to disconnect a live session from the host, and independent or hands-on corroboration of revocation.

support.subject: As a power user, the host shows who is connected right now, and I can disconnect or revoke a device from the host

citations.quote: Sill's Settings › Devices on your Mac lists the devices you paired. Remove one you no longer use, or have lost.
You can remove any of them in Sill’s Settings › Devices on your Mac.
After that, only the devices you paired can connect, and every connection is encrypted.
